item.title: Not-for-profit provider ordered to pay $30,600 after medication error results in National Law breaches
item.description: The State Administrative Tribunal has ordered Goodstart Early Learning Ltd, trading as Goodstart Early Learning Atwell, to pay $30,600 in disciplinary penalties after a three-year-old child received four times the prescribed dose of medication, resulting in multiple breaches of the Education and Care Services National Law (WA) and the Education and Care Services National Regulations (WA).

item.title: ACECQA publishes disability rights and obligations information sheets to support inclusive practice
item.description: The Australian Children's Education and Care Quality Authority (ACECQA) has published a suite of Disability Rights and Obligations Information Sheets to help early childhood education and care (ECEC) services better understand their legal responsibilities and strengthen inclusive practice for children with disability.

item.title: Education ministers continue discussions on strengthening ECEC child safety reforms
item.description: Federal, state and territory education ministers are continuing high-level discussions on a package of reforms aimed at strengthening child safety across Australia's early childhood education and care (ECEC) sector, as governments work to rebuild public confidence following a series of serious alleged child abuse cases.

item.title: National Kitchen Garden Awards return for third year
item.description: Early childhood services across Australia are being invited to showcase their kitchen gardens, with applications now open for the 2026 National Kitchen Garden Awards. The awards celebrate the role kitchen gardens play in connecting children with food, nature and their communities.

item.title: Morcombe family calls for national childcare abuse register
item.description: The parents of Daniel Morcombe have called for the creation of a national childcare abuse register, saying the measure would strengthen child safety by making it harder for people accused or convicted of serious offences against children to move between employers or jurisdictions.
